description: Sign in to Telegram, inspect bounded history, preview resolved messages, and send only under an owner-approved Saved-Messages-only policy.
configHelp: Guide setup with Configure with AI and the Telegram Client view. Get the API ID and API hash at https://my.telegram.org → API development tools → create an application. Never ask the user to paste credentials into chat or return them in command output; have the user enter them in the view, which stores them in the plugin secret store. Start QR authorization with `codeterm plugin telegram-client login`; the QR progress and tg:// authorization link remain in the view for the user to scan from Telegram Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device. Poll `codeterm plugin telegram-client login-status`, then confirm with `codeterm plugin telegram-client health` and `codeterm plugin telegram-client accounts`. Do not use command-line config to move secret values through chat. Install the pinned tg v0.11.0 release into the plugin-owned runtime directory with `node telegram-client/scripts/install-tg.cjs` from the codeterm-plugins checkout. This plugin enables `agent_commands`. Agent verbs include `accounts`, `use <account-id>`, `chats`, `history <chat-id> [n]`, `health`, `logout`, `login`, `login-status`, `preview <chat-id> <text>`, and `send <chat-id> [--key <idempotency-key>] <text>`. Sending is closed until the owner explicitly enables the Saved-Messages-only policy after reviewing the resolved preview. History is capped at 50 messages and 32 KiB. API credentials are supplied in process environment, never arguments. The app_hash is persisted by tg in its YAML config. On macOS sessions use the login Keychain; other platforms store a session file inside this plugin private runtime directory.
